subject.title: feat(agents): screen tool drives Control UI layout (ui.command channel)

question: Should an agent screen command affect only its originating/session-bound Control UI, or intentionally fan out to every capable Control UI connected to the gateway?
rationale: The canonical request describes session-scoped delivery, while the implementation deliberately chooses global fanout; only maintainers can define the permanent cross-client control boundary.

options.title: Scope commands to one UI
options.body: Carry an authoritative originating connection or session-bound target through the tool and gateway, and prove unrelated Control UI clients remain unchanged.

options.title: Approve global fanout
options.body: Keep all-client delivery only with explicit product approval, documentation of multi-client behavior, and live proof covering multiple connected clients.

options.title: Pause screen control
options.body: Defer this phase until the gateway has a stable client-targeting contract suitable for agent-driven UI commands.

recommendation.title: Scope commands to one UI
recommendation.body: Carry an authoritative originating connection or session-bound target through the tool and gateway, and prove unrelated Control UI clients remain unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the canonical feature proposal and this cross-surface implementation, making them the clearest available person to resolve the intended targeting model.
